title: PAR-03 standalone DXF 260-269 unknown classification and binary refusal

localScope.head: de27a33
localScope.worktreeState: The shared worktree is broadly dirty. This scoped classifier/test/plan/receipt slice is uncommitted; no files were staged or committed.

evidence.finding: The published general value-type table does not assign a general type to codes 260-269. The standalone classifier therefore preserves ASCII spelling and does not guess a binary payload width.
The numerical reference likewise resumes general assignments at 270-279 without defining a general value type for 260-269. This is not proof that producer-private or object-context uses do not exist.
A targeted source search found no production getBool(26x), typed writeBool(26x), or case 26x dispatch sites requiring a contextual mapping.

implementation.change: Classify 260-269 as Unknown in StandaloneSafe, retain opaque ASCII spelling, refuse binary parsing and typed/raw writes when no known width exists, and keep the historical Boolean interpretation in the explicit LibreCadMasterLegacy profile.
assertions: Standalone ASCII preserves values for codes 260 and 269 as opaque strings.
Standalone binary reader and writer refuse undocumented 260-269 widths.
Legacy-profile Boolean widths remain explicitly exercised.
Malformed typed raw-value variants are refused without bytes being emitted.
implementation.fixturePolicy: All controls are generated in memory or temporary output; no persistent DWG/DXF fixture was added.

nextAction: Continue the PAR-03 code/context audit for other assigned, unassigned, and producer-specific uses, then self-unblock to the next dependency-ready local implementation item without waiting on external gates.
